tests.procedure: Under strong white light, check each received sample container separately in clean, transparent watch glass or glass dish to detect foreign particles, conformance of colour and compliance with the visual specifications.
tests.source: Omega-3 Fish Oil__Omega-3 Fish Oil - SM AMV aafter edit.txt:30

tests.procedure: Weigh empty pycnometer (W1); fill with water and weigh at 20 C (W2); fill with sample and weigh (W3). S.G. = (W3 - W1) / (W2 - W1).

details.reference: BP Appendix V G (Determination of Weight per Millilitre, Density, Relative Density and Apparent)

tests.source: Omega-3 Fish Oil__Omega-3 Fish Oil - SM AMV aafter edit.txt:31

tests.procedure: Place 5.00 g sample (m g) in a 250 mL conical flask; add 30 mL of 2 volumes chloroform and 3 volumes glacial acetic acid; dissolve; add 0.5 mL saturated potassium iodide solution; shake exactly 1 min; add 30 mL water; titrate with 0.01 M sodium thiosulfate until yellow almost discharged; add 5 mL starch solution; continue titrating with shaking until colour discharged (n1 mL). Blank under same conditions (n2 mL); blank volume must not exceed 0.1 mL. Result given as meq/kg (calculation expression not stated in the text).
tests.source: Omega-3 Fish Oil__Omega-3 Fish Oil - SM AMV aafter edit.txt:32

tests.procedure: Dissolve 10.00 g sample in 50 mL of equal volumes of ethanol (96 per cent) and light petroleum, previously neutralised with 0.1 M potassium or sodium hydroxide; indicator 0.5 mL phenolphthalein solution R1; if needed heat to about 90 C to dissolve and keep at about 90 C during titration; titrate with 0.1 M potassium or sodium hydroxide until pink persists at least 15 s (n mL). Result as mg/g (calculation expression not stated in the text).

details.solvent: ethanol (96 per cent) : light petroleum, equal volumes, 50 mL
details.titrant: 0.1 M potassium hydroxide or 0.1 M sodium hydroxide

tests.source: Omega-3 Fish Oil__Omega-3 Fish Oil - SM AMV aafter edit.txt:33

tests.procedure: Dissolve 0.24 mg/mL sample in isooctane; zero the spectrophotometer with isooctane; read the absorbance at the maximum near 233 nm.
tests.source: Omega-3 Fish Oil__Omega-3 Fish Oil - SM AMV aafter edit.txt:34

tests.procedure: HPLC assay of DHA and EPA (as TG). Standard solution DHA: 104.6 mg working standard in 50 mL ethanolic potassium hydroxide (expected 0.6276 mg/mL). Standard solution EPA: 27.4 mg working standard in 50 mL ethanolic potassium hydroxide, 2 mL diluted to 10 mL. Sample: 2 g oil in 70 mL ethanolic potassium hydroxide, boil in water bath 30 min, cool, make up to 100 mL with ethanolic potassium hydroxide, 3 mL diluted to 50 mL with absolute ethanol. LC, ODS 25 cm column, UV 215 nm, flow rate 1.5 (unit not stated), injection 20 uL. Mobile phase: acetonitrile 65 : buffer 35 (1 mL orthophosphoric acid + 1 g hexane sulfonic acid sodium + 2 mL triethylamine in 1000 mL water). Assay % = (PAt / PAst) x (Act.Wt.std / Theo.Wt.std) x (Theo.Wt.test / Act.Wt.test) x 100.

details.column: ODS, 25 cm (internal diameter and particle size not stated)
details.mobilePhase: acetonitrile 65 : buffer 35; buffer = 1 mL orthophosphoric acid + 1 g hexane sulfonic acid sodium + 2 mL triethylamine in 1000 mL water
